import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static final int M = 25;
    static final int S = 1048580;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int n;
    static int[][] p = new int[N + 1][N + 1];
    static int[][] ma = new int[N + 1][N + 1];
    static int[] bin = new int[M + 1];
    static int[] a = new int[N + 1];
    static int[] b = new int[N + 1];
    static int[] f = new int[S];
    static int[] g = new int[S];
    static int[] tot = new int[1];
    static int[] id = new int[70];
    static int[][] pts = new int[M + 1][N + 1];
    static int[] sta = new int[M + 1];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N + 1];

    static int ksm(int x, int y) {
        long ans = 1;
        long base = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ans;
    }

    static void initialize(Scanner sc) {
        bin[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
            bin[i] = bin[i - 1] * 2;
        }
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv = (int) ksm(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = (int) ((long) p[i][j] * inv % MOD);
            }
        }
        while (n < 6) {
            n++;
            p[n][n] = 1;
        }
    }

    static boolean match_possible(int x) {
        if (x > 3) return true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            if (!vis[i] && ma[a[x]][b[i]] != 0) {
                vis[i] = true;
                boolean res = match_possible(x + 1);
                vis[i] = false;
                if (res) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void explore(int x, int y, long prob) {
        if (x > 3) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= tot[0]; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= 3; j++) {
                    b[j] = pts[i][j];
                }
                if (match_possible(1)) {
                    sum += bin[i - 1];
                }
            }
            f[sum] = (int) ((f[sum] + prob) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        ma[a[x]][y] = 0;
        if (y == n) {
            explore(x + 1, 1, (prob * (long) (MOD - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD));
        } else {
            explore(x, y + 1, (prob * (long) (MOD - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD));
        }
        ma[a[x]][y] = 1;
        if (y == n) {
            explore(x + 1, 1, (prob * p[a[x]][y]) % MOD);
        } else {
            explore(x, y + 1, (prob * p[a[x]][y]) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static void generate(int x, int y, int s) {
        if (y == 3) {
            tot[0]++;
            id[s] = tot[0];
            sta[tot[0]] = s;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                pts[tot[0]][i] = a[i];
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x > n) return;
        generate(x + 1, y, s);
        a[y + 1] = x;
        generate(x + 1, y + 1, s + bin[x - 1]);
    }

    static void prepare() {
        for (int i = 0; i < tot[0]; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < bin[tot[0]]; j++) {
                if ((j & bin[i]) != 0) {
                    g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ bin[i]]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        initialize(sc);
        generate(1, 0, 0);
        a[1] = 1; a[2] = 2; a[3] = 3;
        explore(1, 1, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < bin[tot[0]]; i++) {
            int t = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= tot[0]; j++) {
                int rev = id[bin[n] - 1 - sta[j]];
                if ((i & bin[j - 1]) != 0) {
                    t += bin[rev - 1];
                }
            }
            g[t] = f[i];
            f[i] = 0;
        }
        a[1] = 4; a[2] = 5; a[3] = 6;
        explore(1, 1, 1);
        prepare();
        long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < bin[tot[0]]; i++) {
            answer = (answer + (long) f[i] * g[bin[tot[0]] - 1 - i] % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println((int)((1 - answer + MOD) % MOD));
        sc.close();
    }
}
